::: {.callout-important title="Entry and scope"}
Power Circuits Questions 1-6 must be complete first. Places are limited. Work only on the assigned machines. This pilot does not complete CS01-CS08 early.
:::

## Matched crossover test

Select two computers matched as closely as possible by model, processor, RAM, storage type, and firmware configuration. Use identical USB models, the same USB-port type, the same waiting period, and the same procedure.

| Round | Computer A | Computer B |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Xubuntu live | Mint Xfce live |
| 2 | Mint Xfce live | Xubuntu live |

Live-USB boot time is not a fair computer-performance benchmark.

## Individual tests

Use **Pass / Concern / Fail** for display, keyboard, mouse, cursor stability, USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, sound, and internal-storage visibility. Compare idle memory after the same waiting period, browser launch, Tinkercad, Inkscape, VS Code, settings clarity, and the installation/update experience.

Use **Green / Yellow / Red** only for the final overall machine classification.

## Safety and approval gates

Never open or probe inside a PSU. Shut down and unplug before opening. Protect privacy and use the approved ESD controls. A teacher signature is required before power after opening and before erasing, partitioning, installing, replacing storage, or moving RAM.

## Decision

The teacher may select Xubuntu as the classroom standard, Mint Xfce as the classroom standard, Lubuntu for weak machines, or additional testing. After Thanksgiving, CS01-CS08 uses the selected system to commission, upgrade, benchmark, and recommend a classroom computer.
